rdfs:label: audience
rdfs:comment: The intended audience of the object — who it is targeted at, regardless of who actually receives it.
notes: Used to declare semantic targeting (e.g. "this is for friends", "this is for the engineering team") independently of `as:to`/`as:cc` (which are wire-level addressing). The value can be an Actor, Collection, or symbolic IRI like `as:Public`. This is `as:audience`; it is not `dcterms:audience` (a dcterms AgentClass for whom a resource is intended), which has no registry term.

history.note: Disambiguated as:audience from dcterms:audience. Added reciprocal notToBeConfusedWith links.
